title: Inam ka lalach (Lottery SMS)
situation: Aapke phone par SMS aata hai: 'Mubarak ho! Aap 500,000 jeet gaye hain. Inam haasil karne ke liye is link par click karein: http://bit.ly/fake-lottery'
options: Fauran link par click karunga aur apni maloomat de dunga taake inam mil jaye.
Link par click nahi karunga lekin number par call kar ke tasdeeq karunga.
Message ko ignore karunga, SMS delete aur number block kar dunga.

title: Bank se Call (OTP Theft)
situation: Aapko call aati hai, shakhs kehta hai: 'Main aapke bank/Easypaisa se baat kar raha hoon, aapka account block hone wala hai. Aapke phone par ek OTP aaya hoga, wo batayein taake account theek kar saku.'
options: Pareshan ho kar fauran OTP bata dunga taake account theek rahay.
Call kaat dunga aur khud official helpline ya app open kar ke check karunga.
Unhe ghalat OTP bataunga maze lene ke liye.

title: Muft WiFi ka Khatra (Public Network)
situation: Aap airport ya cafe mein hain. 'Free_Internet_Public' ke naam se ek bina password ka WiFi milta hai. Aapko apni banking app se balance transfer karna hai.
options: Fauran free WiFi se connect kar ke apna bank app kholunga.
Banking ke liye hamesha apna Mobile Data (4G) istemal karunga, ya VPN lagaunga.
WiFi connect karunga lekin sirf browser par login karunga app mein nahi.

title: La-waris USB (Found Flash Drive)
situation: Aapko park ya raste mein ek chamakti hui nayi USB milti hai jis par 'Private Photos' ka label laga hai.
options: Apne computer mein laga kar dekhunga ke isme aakhir hai kya.
Apne kisi dost ke computer mein laga kar try karunga.
Isko hargiz kisi computer mein nahi lagaunga, isme malware ya virus ho sakta hai.

title: Dost ka WhatsApp (Account Takeover)
situation: Aapke bohot qareebi dost ka WhatsApp message aata hai: 'Yaar mera accident ho gaya hai, mujhe fauran is number par 15,000 rupay Easypaisa kar do, baad mein bataunga.'
options: Baghair soche samjhe dosti ke khatir fauran paise bhej dunga.
Usay direct normal sim par call karunga aur confirm karunga ke kya waqai wo musibat mein hai.
Usay WhatsApp par message karunga ke 'theek hai bhej raha hoon'.
